status: COMPUTATIONAL — AI-assisted research. No physical thermal-vacuum validation has been performed. The TVAC coupon test is the falsification gate for the central thermal claim.
stopping_boundary_explanation: Additional purely computational iterations cannot credibly improve the result because: (1) in Regime C3, the non-thermal spacecraft subsystem floor (PV + eclipse storage + ADCS/shielding = 22.5 kg/kW) and launch/replenishment overhead make even a zero-mass radiator more expensive per compute-year than terrestrial clean-grid power ($1,384/kW-yr); and (2) in Regime C1/C2, MS-OHP-SP's remaining uncertainty is the physical microgravity oscillation startup threshold and contact conductance across the brazed AlSiC/MoCu boss, which requires an external Thermal-Vacuum (TVAC) chamber measurement rather than further simulation.

round_progression.action_taken: REJECT A06_NAIVE_PUMPED_MIF_PWS_STRUCTURAL and A08_LIQUID_DROPLET_RADIATOR_LDR; ADOPT Conventional Incumbent A04_CONV_LIGHTWEIGHT_RADIATOR_INCUMBENT (5.423 kg/kW screening, 6.817 kg/kW coupled) as the new Round 2 baseline.
round_progression.bottleneck_targeted: Chip-sized package radiates only 2.427 W at 80 C; 150 kW requires 125.15 m^2 radiator area; naive pumped MIF-PWS structural panel weighs 9.345 kg/kW (screen) / 10.500 kg/kW (coupled) vs 5.423 kg/kW / 6.817 kg/kW for the conventional lightweight radiator incumbent (A04) and fails under single MMOD loop perforation (23.9% 5-yr loop-drain risk).

round_progression.action_taken: INVENT & ADOPT A09_ROUND2_INVENTION_MS_OHP_SP (Monolithic 64-Cell/m^2 Structural Oscillating-Heat-Pipe + Direct Backside Die Attach + Solid Coaxial Busbar Skin). Deletes TIM1/Lid/Coldplate/Pumps, cuts dT_chain from 18.0 K to 8.2 K (+9.8 K higher radiator temperature -> +14.8% higher W/m^2 flux from temperature alone, +18.8% including the higher end-of-life emissivity), reaches 3.458 kg/m^2 net effective areal density (< 5.083 kg/m^2 break-even) and 2.725 kg/kW coupled thermal mass (-60.0% vs A04) with 99.86% 5-yr MMOD survival.
round_progression.bottleneck_targeted: On Adopted Baseline A04, 4 intermediate thermal interfaces (TIM1, Lid, Coldplate saddle, CCHP evaporator) drop radiator root temperature by 18.0 K (reducing T^4 emission) and require separate bus skin + radiator support mass (effective areal density 6.50 kg/m^2 > 5.083 kg/m^2 break-even).

round_progression.action_taken: SPLIT-REGIME ADOPTION: (1) For Regime C3 (Terrestrial-User General AI), ADOPT A11_TERRESTRIAL_CLEAN_GRID_DRYCOOL ($1,384.33/kW-yr vs $10,596.04/kW-yr for best orbital A09 at $1,500/kg launch, and $1,384.33 vs $2,622.31/kW-yr even at $100/kg aspirational launch) and REJECT orbital data centers for bulk terrestrial workloads; (2) For Regime C1/C2 (Space-Native EO/SAR/Hyperspectral/ISL Triage), INVENT & ADOPT A10_ROUND3_INVENTION_SPARSE_ORBITAL_EDGE_MS_OHP (Event-Gated Sparse Triage + MS-OHP-SP + Demisable C-SiC Low-Alumina Bus), beating terrestrial raw downlink by 3.06x (and the modeled Suncatcher-class A02 baseline by 20.25x) in actionable scenes/$ while cutting re-entry Al2O3 ablation by -84.0%.
round_progression.bottleneck_targeted: Full spacecraft mass (25.54 kg/kW even with MS-OHP-SP due to PV, batteries, ADCS, shielding) + launch cost + space-to-ground communication ceiling (JPL arXiv:2604.27197) + re-entry Al2O3 ozone pollution.
